problems.what: sit rather than lie down when you tend to daydream, dissociate or fall asleep; lying down is for sleep, deep rest or dream incubation (not 'sit in a place where you won't daydream')
problems.replace: Make sure you are not lying down when you do this exercise, unless you are ready to go to sleep or receive deep rest or are trying to incubate dreams. Sit in a place where you will not find yourself daydreaming, dissociating or going to sleep.
